best_section.where: on the dirt track at the pin, between two ponds/dams in the bush off Avalon Road

summary: Secluded bush track between ponds, but narrow, sandy and quite steep with no obvious turning space.
reasons: Deep in bush, no buildings nearby
Track looks narrow with no clear pull-off

drivers.seclusion: Excellent — dense scrub and two dams on all sides, no dwellings in sight, no sign of foot or vehicle traffic in either capture.
drivers.access_and_room: A single dirt track runs through, roughly one vehicle wide; no visible gate, but no obvious widened spot to pull a van fully clear or turn around.
drivers.traffic: No road at all — this is an off-road bush track, so no passing traffic expected, but surface condition for a 2WD van is unclear.
drivers.convention: Not applicable — no other vehicles visible on the track in either image to confirm it's used for parking.

flags: Steep: around 7-8% average grade, up to 11% in places
Track surface looks sandy/soft in both captures — could bog a 2WD van
No confirmed turning space; a van may need to reverse out
sun_shade: Mostly shaded — overhung by tree canopy from most directions, with small open clearings near the ponds to the north.
cannot_judge: Whether a gate exists further along the access route
Whether there's a turning point within the 100 m search radius
